title: Public project creator attribution and canonical creator link
purpose: Use the SESH-052 presentation resolver on the human public project page and optionally render canonical public creator attribution.
resolution: Read only the dynamic projectId route parameter.
Preserve the explicit-public project boundary established by SESH-052.
Map invalid-input and not-found to page 404.
Map unavailable or invariant failure to page 503.

creatorPresentation.behaviorWhenAbsent: Render the public project normally without creator attribution.

privacyBoundary: Do not infer account or legal identity.
The canonical creator handle is used only as an already-public vanity route identifier.
Do not expose project lifecycle, revision, media graph, storage, or private metadata.
apiBoundary: Do not change the existing anonymous public-project JSON API.
Do not add creator attribution to the JSON API in this increment.
Human page navigation targets /sesh/[handle]/ rather than an API route.
rightsBoundary: Attribution does not grant or imply copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, management, label, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, CRM, account, or identity rights.
scope: No commit in the authoring step.
